title: Colors in sequence / Creator Week

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Coordinate color across neighboring panels so a viewer reads a campaign as a sequence.
strategic_value: Varied hues can sustain interest across Instagram placements while the shared palette links them.
demonstration: Four adjacent displays alternate purple, pink, orange and white; a small palette diagram underneath traces selected hues.
practical_value: Review neighboring placements together when distributing colors across a campaign.

content_islands.spec: Align the four tall Creator Week executions against the tiled wall.

content_islands.name: Palette path
content_islands.spec: Center the three-row color-dot diagram below and retain its connecting line.

reference_purposes.Expression: Adjacent executions show distinct hues within one campaign.
reference_purposes.Application: The palette path demonstrates color selection across a four-panel placement.

ingredient.name: Sequential campaign color
ingredient.role: Link neighboring panels without making them identical.
ingredient.application: Distribute related palette colors across the sequence as demonstrated.
ingredient.scope: The pictured Creator Week sequence; the path is an example rather than a mandatory ordering for every campaign.
